freeze_policy: Local clean published 1TB development is permitted; four-machine pinned-environment preflight required to freeze or launch distributed evaluation. No budget-specific retuning.

HEST_Benchmark.grouping: Official sample_id CSV folds; patient mapping unavailable
HEST_Benchmark.estimator: Train-only StandardScaler/PCA256; Ridge lsqr no-intercept max_iter1000, alpha=multiplier*100/(256*genes)
HEST_Benchmark.selection_limitation: 1TB outer evaluation folds used only for agreed protocol development; selected 1TB score is not unbiased confirmation. Multiplier search is PROPOSED_BY_US.
HEST_Benchmark.aggregation: Equal genes within fold, equal official folds within tissue; canonical nine tissues macro average; HCC reported separately

CellFMCount.grouping: Released image identity and decoded-pixel duplicates; biological specimen mapping unavailable
CellFMCount.split: Source test retained except three conflicting-count observations; quarantine all 12 DAPI members of six source-conflict groups, hold out ceil10% surviving trainval for validation

preprocessing.image_normalization: Existing grayscale minmax RGB and mean-color square padding; ImageNet RGB

CellFMCount.aggregation: Pooled image-count MAE primary, R2 and Spearman secondary; curated test scope 272, not original275
limitations: Official source annotation conflicts quarantined, never averaged or silently selected
Finite source edge clicks retained for scalar count; no localization interpretation

AllenCell_Morphology.grouping: PlateId:WellId, FOVs and all cell crops kept together
AllenCell_Morphology.split: Released Task_two unseen-structure test wells; merge Train/Task_one, ceil10% whole wells for deterministic SHA256 validation; decoded duplicate cleanup

preprocessing.image_normalization: Existing flattened multichannel percentile loader; three real WTC-11 channels, auto channel policy, fixed1TB microscopy mean/std

AllenCell_Morphology.aggregation: Pooled cell MAE in log1p-volume units; R2/Spearman secondary
limitations: Official CHAMMI classification source, proposed regression task

CytoImageNet.grouping: Released idx original source image; decoded exact duplicates cleaned
CytoImageNet.split: Per-class source-group SHA256 order, ceil10% test and validation each; exclude classes with fewer than three surviving source groups

preprocessing.image_normalization: Released grayscale RGB conversion and existing ImageNet eval transform

CytoImageNet.aggregation: Micro image accuracy primary; macro class balanced accuracy secondary
limitations: Official crop-random split has 64805 source IDs crossing train/val; repaired protocol is not official894-class reproduction
Upstream donor/well provenance and training-corpus overlap remain separate checks

VGG_Cell_Counting.grouping: Independent synthetic source image, no derived crops
VGG_Cell_Counting.split: Official first100 development / second100 test; five N32 train/N32 validation draws from development, proposed deterministic seeds0..4

preprocessing.image_normalization: Native RGB full256x256 field, ImageNet RGB

VGG_Cell_Counting.aggregation: Equal mean of five per-draw validation MAEs for selection; frozen evaluation mean/population SD of five test MAEs on same100 images
limitations: Global-feature scalar count baseline, not density/MESA reproduction
Research-only noncommercial code terms and requiredcitation; no separate explicit standalone image archive license or commercial permission

FILM.grouping: Named biological sample; average paired D6_sample1 FOV embeddings, all126 spectral planes inseparable
FILM.split: Repeated stratified sample-group3fold outer CV, seeds0/1/2; independent3fold inner CV within each outer training partition

preprocessing.image_normalization: Released SPEND-denoised126-band stacks, shared whole-stack p1/p99 clipping, fixed spectral mean replicatedRGB; fixed1TB microscopy mean/std

FILM.aggregation: Select feature/C separately for each of9 outer folds from its3 inner folds only; freeze all9 recipes. Equal fold means then equal seed means; population seed SD is not independent-cohort uncertainty
limitations: 27 named groups/28 FOV stacks only; hidden animal/batch linkage unavailable
Spectral-mean RGB loses chemical information, not native spectroscopy or lysosome assay reproduction
Author SPEND denoising training provenance not assigned to our folds; CC-BY4.0 released-data observational benchmark

OpenCell.grouping: ENSG protein identity; all cell lines and FOVs of protein together
OpenCell.split: At least10 eligible single-grade3 proteins/class; stable SHA256 choose up to16/class, then per-class default_rng(seed) protein permutation: ceil15% test, ceil15% validation, remainder training; ALL selected protein FOVs
OpenCell.scope: 215 proteins,14 localization classes,1064 official projection FOVs, subset of6301 available

preprocessing.image_normalization: Official two-channel projection: per-FOV minmax taggedprotein channel1 to red, Hoechst channel0 to green, blue zero, full-FOV square padding; ImageNet RGB

OpenCell.aggregation: Macro class balanced FOV accuracy primary; image accuracy/macroF1 secondary
limitations: Proposed FOV projection task, not Cytoself cell-crop reproduction
Public raw images CC-BY-SA4.0; figure-analysis code license not used to infer data terms
